scientific_integrity: Complete direct symbolic proof supplied; finite exact-rational illustrative checker does not replace the universal proof. The classical Hilbert simplex norm formula is credited rather than presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Only isometric embedding and its nonhyperbolicity consequence are proved; not a global identification or convexity theorem for the full moduli. Stronger unlocated historical results and independent verification remain open.
title: Arbitrarily high-dimensional variation-norm flats in symbolic quasimorphism moduli
